run_reduced_mcts_evaluation: run the reduced MCTS evaluation loop using the rlpytorch evaluator and game controller
load_env_with_actor_only: load the rlpytorch environment with actor_only=True overrides for evaluation mode
create_evaluator_with_stats: create an rlpytorch Evaluator instance with stats disabled for reduced MCTS evaluation
register_reduced_state_callbacks: register reduced_project, reduced_forward, and reduced_predict callbacks on the game controller
run_eval_iters_loop: run the evaluation iteration loop calling GC.Run for each iteration from EvalIters
